title: Renewal Wrangler: Cadence Canvas (QBR Template)

probability_guidelines: Heuristics used for the Renewal Probability column: 0–25% = Procurement/Legal blockers exist; 26–50% = Engagement gaps or budget risks; 51–75% = Active negotiation with clear path; 76–100% = Commitments in place (contract, PO, or explicit exec confirmation). Use escalation tiers to trigger appropriate interventions.
qbr_notes: How to use in a QBR: 1) Filter rows by Escalation Tier for SLT review. 2) Highlight any >$250k ARR accounts with probability <60% for immediate exec outreach. 3) Pull top 5 at-risk accounts into the pre-QBR working session with Sales Eng and Solutions. 4) Add a one-slide summary with ARR at-risk rollup and proposed mitigations.
next_actions_checklist: Standard next-step tags: legal-review, billing-confirm, exec-brief, technical-workshop, cost-modeling, pilot-cutback, PO-followup. For each action include owner and due date in Next Steps column.
internal_meta: Created as a compact sprintboard for weekly renewal standups and QBR prep; intentionally minimal columns to be exported into slide templates. Owner maintains this sheet; canonical Confluence page linked in linked_artifacts.
notes: Draft status — please add playbook improvements and local tactics used in the field. Recommended to sync with Solutions Engineering (ticket SE-992) before finalizing the QBR slide pack.
